name: Thaddaeus
summary: One of the twelve apostles, also called Lebbaeus and Judas the brother of James. He is not Judas Iscariot, the one who betrayed Jesus.

key_moments.title: Chosen as One of the Twelve
key_moments.description: After Jesus prayed all night on a mountain, He called His disciples and chose twelve of them, whom He named apostles. Thaddaeus, named here as Judas the brother of James, was one of the twelve.

key_moments.title: Sent Out to Preach and Heal
key_moments.description: Jesus gave the twelve power to cast out unclean spirits and to heal every kind of sickness and disease, and sent them out. Thaddaeus, called here Lebbaeus whose surname was Thaddaeus, is named among them.

key_moments.title: Asks Jesus Why He Shows Himself Only to Them
key_moments.description: Judas, not Judas Iscariot, asked Jesus how He would show Himself to the disciples and not to the world. Jesus answered that if a man loves Him, he will keep His words, and the Father and He will come and make their home with him.
